This has become our go-to place whenever we’re craving great Vietnamese food. The Hoi An-inspired setting is absolutely beautiful, with colourful lanterns, charming décor, and a peaceful pond filled with fish that creates a relaxing and authentic atmosphere.

The food is consistently delicious, but the Vietnamese salad is the standout for me. It’s incredibly fresh and refreshing, with the perfect balance of tangy, sweet, savoury, and crunchy flavours. I look forward to ordering it every time we visit.

It’s also a wonderful place for families. Seeing children happily playing around gives the restaurant a warm and lively atmosphere, and the picturesque surroundings make it easy to spend time taking photos.

The staff are genuinely friendly and welcoming, which made the experience even more memorable.

The only small downside was that we got bitten by a few mosquitoes while sitting indoors, probably because of the open-air design and the nearby pond. It wasn’t enough to spoil the experience, but it’s something to be aware of.

Update: We’ve now been back twice since our first visit, and every experience has been just as enjoyable. The food, service, and atmosphere have remained consistently excellent, making this our default choice for Vietnamese food. Highly recommended!
